alphabet-run.title: Alphabet Run 3D: Collect Alphabets & Defeat the Monster
alphabet-run.slogan: Welcome to Alphabet Run 3D, an amazing game!
alphabet-run.description: Welcome to Alphabet Run 3D, an exciting game where you play as Alphabet A. Your mission is to collect as many alphabets as possible to defeat the blue monster. Choose the same color as your player to multiply your alphabets. Enjoy the thrill of Alphabet Run 3D and start your adventure today!
